Subject: Re: Initial ask — SLA credit buckets + on-call coverage pricing

Hi Kelly — thanks for the clear list. Quick summary of how we typically handle each item and a proposed path forward: 

1) SLA credit model: we offer a bucketed monthly credit approach for large customers. Example bands (monthly):
   - Bronze: up to 4 credits / month (1–4 minor incidents)
   - Silver: up to 12 credits / month (covers transient multi-region flaps)
   - Gold: 25+ credits / month with per-incident weekends covered
   Credits are applied as percentage-of-bill rebates based on uptime impact. This avoids per-incident disputes and covers multi-model events. See attached SLA_Tiers_v3.pdf for percentages and calculation examples.

2) 24/7 on-call escalation: we can provide an optional add-on that includes a named SRE, phone escalation, and quarterly runbook updates. Two pricing options: a flat monthly retainer (preferred for predictable budgeting) or a usage-linked surcharge during escalation hours.

3) Priority routing for launch: we can enable a temporary fast-path routing policy for a 30-day launch window for a reduced ramp fee (one-time) plus an hourly premium for fast-path tokens. Alternatively, include a short-term uplift to your committed capacity for the window.

Proposed next step: I'll send a counter that maps your expected peak qps and commitment term to the three bundles (bucket band, on-call retainer, launch fast-path). If that looks good we can move to a mutual action plan (MAP) and have legal prep a short SOW.

I'll loop in Marissa (Customer Success) to coordinate runbooks and onboarding cadence.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Sales Manager — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Team — summary of recommended counter for Acme Cloud (high priority opportunity):

- Base ask: 12 month commitment, targeted 50M tokens/month peak, US region only for now.
- Offer: Gold bucket limited to 18 credits/mo, 10% credit rebate on downtime (see pdf math), 24/7 named SRE retainer at $12k/mo (includes quarterly runbook refresh), launch fast-path enabled for 30 days with a $5k ramp fee + 20% token premium during the window.
- Discounting levers: 1) Move to 24-month term => additional 10% off platform fees. 2) Prepay annual => 8% off retainer and platform token fees. 3) Legal acceptance of our standard SOW => expedite onboarding calendar by 2 weeks (non-dollar concession).

Risks / asks for this thread: please confirm whether we can compress the onboarding calendar if they prepay; Marissa — can your team commit to an earlier runbook draft (within 5 business days of contract signature)? Aditya — do we have approval to offer up to 15% platform fee discount without leadership sign-off?

Thanks,
Priya

Hi Kelly / Samir — thanks for the patience while we coordinated internally. Below is our counteroffer that maps to your procurement model. If this aligns we'll draft a short SOW and MAP and send to procurement for signature.

Counter (12-month term):
- Platform fees: standard token pricing (see attached MAP for banding) with a 15% volume discount applied for 12-month prepay.
- SLA credit bucket: Gold* 18 credits/month. Credit calculation: see SLA_Tiers_v3.pdf — refundable as percentage-of-bill rebates applied monthly.
- 24/7 Named SRE retainer: $12,000/month (includes phone escalation, 2-hour target response for Sev1, quarterly runbook update, and one on-prem consult day per quarter if needed).
- Launch fast-path: 30-day window, $4,500 one-time ramp fee (reduced from initial ask), 15% token premium on fast-path tokens during the window.
- One-time onboarding credit: we'll apply a $10k onboarding credit to first invoice if MAP is signed within 10 business days.

Negotiation notes: we can increase the rebate percentage on SLA credits by 3 points if you move to a 24-month commitment or prepay both platform and retainer. We prefer to keep legal language to the attached SOW so timelines are preserved.

Next steps: please confirm you want the MAP and SOW as-is or with redlines. Procurement, if you can share an editable SOW link we can triage legal comments quickly.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick 20-minute call to finalize.

Best,
